title: Page 313
transc:
Jaques  Washn DC Oct 5th 9 am 1863 
Buxton I can only repeat former
instructions to leave sufficient force in
the upper end of the Valley
to hold Jones in check and
with the remainder to march down
north side of Godwin Spartan guarding
the fords and connecting with Bennet
I can not make them plainer
Applause Fanny fine weather here today


W. B. Kelly  Washington Oct 5th 10 A. M. 1863 
Valley Kelly Vermont Lock wood will
take first Shylock Eastern shore Census
spunky and report for orders to
the commanding officer middle department at
Image sig Abortion Florence cold windy


Sheldon  Washington D. C. Oct 6th 1863
For Vernon Fos - ter An
other Shylock of colored youth
is ready in Clyde Do
you want them sent to
Hammer Abortion Catharine take em
